description: This file implements CityHash64 and related hash functions, including helper functions for hashing strings of various lengths, and internal utilities for byte fetching and bit manipulation.

methods.name: Fetch64
methods.description: Fetches 64 bits from a byte pointer, considering endianness.

methods.name: Fetch32
methods.description: Fetches 32 bits from a byte pointer, considering endianness.

methods.name: Mur
methods.description: Helper function to combine two 32-bit values into a hash.

methods.name: Hash32Len13to24
methods.description: Hash function for strings of length 13 to 24.

methods.name: Hash32Len0to4
methods.description: Hash function for strings of length 0 to 4.

methods.name: Hash32Len5to12
methods.description: Hash function for strings of length 5 to 12.

methods.name: CityHash32
methods.description: Computes a 32-bit hash for a string.

methods.name: HashLen0to16
methods.description: Hash for strings of length 0 to 16.

methods.name: HashLen17to32
methods.description: Hash for strings of length 17 to 32.

methods.name: WeakHashLen32WithSeeds
methods.description: Generates a 16-byte hash for 32 bytes with seed values.

methods.name: HashLen33to64
methods.description: Hash for strings of length 33 to 64.

methods.name: CityHash64
methods.description: Main function to compute 64-bit hash for strings of arbitrary length.
